messages:
erin: deploy-bot shows session-store chart v6.2.0 canary failing in us-west-2 at 10%: init job reports PVC resize timeout, pods stuck Pending. tagging @db-team @sre-oncall. rollback or patch?
deploy-bot: Canary paused. Event: PersistentVolumeClaim \"session-store-data-xxxx\" failed to resize: resize call timed out after 5m. (bot)
noah: 6.2.0 bumped the storage class and enabled autoResize: true. our cluster's CSI driver in us-west-2 currently requires controller restart to pick up resize. storage team is on it but could take ~20m.
carlos: options: 1) rollback to 6.1.9 and pin chart in promotion manifest for us-west-2 (safe); 2) wait for CSI fix and re-run canary (20m); 3) hotpatch chart to disable autoResize in values overlay and re-run canary (fast).
sre-oncall: If users could be impacted (session writes failing) we should prefer rollback for stability. Can we hotpatch overlay quickly?
ero: sorry typo — erin: hotpatch overlay is quick: set storage.autoResize: false in values/us-west-2 and re-run canary. downside: manual migration later needed for growth.
noah: storage team says restarting the csi-controller will likely restore resize and they can do that in ~12m with low risk. given ETA, maybe wait 15m; otherwise choose option 1 or 3.
carlos: if we wait and it doesn't resolve, rollback path: `deploy-bot promote --chart session-store:6.1.9 --region us-west-2 --force-rollback && deploy-bot pin --chart session-store:6.1.9 --region us-west-2`
deploy-bot: Note: promotion pipeline will retry v6.2.0 unless manifest pinned. Consider pin if rolling back.
erin: decision: wait up to 15m for CSI restart. if no resolution, hotpatch overlay to disable autoResize and re-run canary; if overlay CI fails or canary still fails we'll rollback. holding promotion window for us-west-2 for 40m to avoid cross-region impact.
storage-team: CSI controller restart scheduled and performed. reports: controller restarted at +7m, resize now responding.
noah: checking canary artifacts: after CSI restart PVC resized successfully for new pod, init job completed, pods coming up. 5xxs back to baseline.
carlos: great. since this was an infra gap, we should still add a presubmit check that flags chart changes enabling autoResize and require storage-team signoff. Opening ticket: https://git.company/infra/issues/980
erin: release-bot, please add a short blurb: session-store v6.2.0 canary transiently failed due to regional CSI controller needing restart for PVC resize; resolved by controller restart and canary completed.
release-bot: Added note: \"Session-store v6.2.0 canary in us-west-2 experienced PVC resize timeouts due to outdated CSI controller. Resolved via controller restart; no rollback required. Action: add storage gating to promotion checklist and monitor resize metrics during next promotion.\"
carlos: follow-up owner: noah to validate presubmit check, storage-team to run a housekeeping sweep on CSI versions across regions.
erin: recap: waited for infra fix, canary progressed to 50% then 100%. promotion window released. cc @db-team for postmortem item. :white_check_mark:
